content.raw:
Bone marrow (stem cell) transplantation is a complex, multi-stage treatment that calls for close teamwork between laboratories, clinical units and nursing staff. The transplant clinic at our partner hospital brings these stages together under one roof, from diagnostic work-up and treatment planning to follow-up after discharge. MedLuxLife helps adult patients and their families prepare medical records, arrange evaluation and stay well informed throughout a lengthy treatment journey.

Treatments and services

Transplant outpatient clinic

Coordinates assessment, decision-making, treatment and follow-up for patients who are being considered for, or are undergoing, a transplant, reviewing previous treatment, imaging, pathology and laboratory findings together.

Apheresis unit

Collects stem cells from the blood as part of the transplant process.

Stem cell freezing and processing

Processes stem cells and stores them cryogenically in nitrogen tanks, with separate quarantine and main storage, using an automated freezing system.

Flow cytometry laboratory

Analyses blood and marrow cells to support diagnosis, treatment planning and assessment of the response to treatment.

HLA tissue typing laboratory

Performs tissue typing used to assess compatibility between patient and donor.

Genetic diagnostic support

Works alongside a genetic diagnosis centre so that genetic findings can inform diagnosis and treatment decisions.

Protected transplant unit

Treatment takes place in single rooms within a dedicated unit with HEPA air filtration throughout, controlled disinfection on entry and beds that can be converted for emergency care.

Comfort and wellbeing

Rooms are designed with views and patient comfort in mind to support psychological wellbeing during a long hospital stay.

Follow-up before and after transplant

Patients are monitored closely at every stage, and follow-up continues after discharge with the involvement of social support teams.

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Haematology and pathology reports, including bone marrow biopsy results
  • Details of previous chemotherapy or other treatment received

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Adult Bone Marrow Transplantation consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Request a Free Consultation

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.
